Last Friday, Tom and Sam went to the gym. Life is full of small surprises. Sam is interested in cooking. Grandma affectionately calls her old dog Little Bear.
Tom hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Tom usually has salad for breakfast. They took many photos at the running track.
